findings.evidence: `rg -n "@\[expose\].*coinvariantsEquivHom|coinvariantsEquivHom_apply|coinvariantsEquivHom_symm_apply_coe" code/TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule/Coinvariants.lean` shows `@[expose] noncomputable def coinvariantsEquivHom` at line 199 and public simp characterization lemmas at lines 226 and 234.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` from the equivalence and keep the public characterization lemmas opaque, e.g. by proving/exporting them without requiring consumers to unfold the definition (`:= (rfl)` where applicable, or non-defeq proofs).
findings.issue: `coinvariantsEquivHom` is declared `@[expose]`, so downstream code can unfold and depend on the structure-literal implementation of the universal-property equivalence.

findings.evidence: `nl -ba code/TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule/Coinvariants.lean` shows unannotated declarations at lines 264, 289, and 304, while the coinvariant counterparts are tagged `@[simp]` at lines 82, 132, and 146.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to these invariant normal-form lemmas, matching `mem_coinvariants`, `mapCoinvariants_coe_apply`, and `mapCoinvariants_comp`.
findings.issue: The invariant-specialized characteristic lemmas `mem_invariants`, `mapInvariants_coe_apply`, and `mapInvariants_comp` are untagged, so the public `invariants` API does not get the same normal-form automation as the parallel coinvariant API.

summary: The public surface still exposes the universal-property equivalence body and leaves invariant-specialized normal forms out of simp automation. These are fixable API issues.
